NIPS0001.ol:
#  The intention behind this synthetic parameter is to be able to add the
#  release number to the MIB.
#
#  @see NIPS0000 for more explanations

return (4.9 + 0 * NIPH0001.raw);

NXAS014R.ol:
###########################################################
# This synthetic calculates the consistency of the
# instantiated service 12 packet for SMON 14 of PID 11
#
# In case the order in which the monitors are reported
# in the generic service 12 packet, this synthetic
# will flag the incorrectly parsed monitors as invalid.
#
# Returns 1 if the parsed and intended monitoring IDs match
#         0 otherwise
#
###########################################################

if (NXAS014A.raw == 14) then
   return (1);
else
   return (0);
endif;
